description: Move a task to a different billing project within your organization. Both the task and the destination project must belong to your organization. Requires Manager role or above.

idempotency_key.description: Optional caller-supplied key; retrying with the same key returns the original result instead of acting twice.

new_project_id.description: ID of the destination project (required, must belong to your organization).

task_id.description: ID of the task to move (required).

name: move_task
